svg.text: ESP32-C3 SuperMini to the SX1278 Ra-02 breakout with jumper wires
Same pins as the socket adapter. Both boards seen from the back, header pins towards you.
GPIO5 strap to GPIO0 (firmware drives GPIO0 low to read it)
DIO2 is not on the header: solder the black wire to the
module's pin-7 castellation, or the land just outside it,
on the face away from the header pins.
